# Test failure

TypeScript typecheck passed; eslint + custom lints passed. `npm test` failed: root vitest 32 files failed / 781 passed / 4 skipped, 76 tests failed / 8092 passed / 52 skipped. All failures are beforeEach hook timeouts (5000ms) in setupOverdeckTestDb() across unrelated infrastructure tests. Targeted PAN-2158-related tests passed (4 files, 107 tests). No browser UAT required. Failures appear to be pre-existing test-infrastructure flakiness under load, not regressions from PAN-2158 changes.

## Required
Fix the failing tests, commit and push, then re-run `pan done PAN-2158`.
